name: Vendor Renewal Tracker
summary: An application to keep a list of vendors with renewal dates, sorted automatically by the next renewal.

items.title: Vendor database
items.description: Store all vendor records securely including names and renewal dates.
items.proved_when: Vendor records can be successfully stored and retrieved.
items.source_quote: Keep a list of our vendors with their renewal dates

items.title: Vendor renewal table
items.description: Display vendors in a clear table sorted by the next upcoming renewal.
items.proved_when: The user sees the vendor list ordered by the nearest renewal date.
items.source_quote: show them in a table sorted by the next renewal

items.title: Add vendor form
items.description: A simple form to input new vendor details and renewal dates.
items.proved_when: A new vendor can be added through the interface and appears in the table.
items.source_quote: Keep a list of our vendors

not_in_this_version.title: Automated renewal email alerts
not_in_this_version.reason: Not requested in the core requirements.
